signal: ZEDEDA raised $72M Series C and unveiled its Edge Intelligence Platform at NVIDIA GTC 2026, plus a Submer partnership for edge AI infrastructure.

email.body1:
Sudhir, saw ZEDEDA raised $72M and unveiled the Edge Intelligence Platform at GTC.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for ZEDEDA off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Sudhir, quick follow-up for ZEDEDA.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline tend to jump faster than headcount can. Most strategic sales directors don't actually know how many booked meetings it takes to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ZEDEDA needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Sudhir, last bit of proof for ZEDEDA.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ZEDEDA's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage infra startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Sudhir, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most right after a raise, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your edge motion? I'll tailor it to ZEDEDA either way.
